summary: FAIL on one blocker. analysis/answers/R02.json has a caveat that reads the customer-basis refund rate as an order-level rate and calls it low: it says fewer than one order in ten is refunded. The data show 27 of 57 paying customers (0.473684) and 33 of 174 order rows (0.189655), so the sentence is false on either basis. Every published number reproduces exactly from raw_data/orders.csv using this red team's own code. That covers net revenue 35741.52, the PL/DE/CZ figures 11181.67/11032.61/13527.24 (which sum to the headline), refund rate 27/57 = 0.473684, and row accounting 201 = 174 + 26 + 1.
